traits.name: Death Burst
traits.text: The mephit explodes when it dies. _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. _Failure:_ 5 (2d4) Cold damage. _Success:_ Half damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +3, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.

actions.name: Fog Cloud (1/Day)
actions.text: The mephit casts _Fog Cloud_, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Frost Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. _Failure:_ 7 (3d4) Cold damage. _Success:_ Half damage.
